{{NPC infobox | type = Elemental | affiliation = Vabbi wildlife | profession = me | level = 20 (26), 24 (26) | campaign = Nightfall | name = Roaring Ether | image = [[File:Roaring Ether.jpg|200px]] }}__NOTOC__ [[Roaring Ether (Vabbi)|Roaring Ethers]] are found in [[Vabbi]] and often accompanied by a combination of [[Ruby Djinn|Ruby]], [[Diamond Djinn|Diamond]] and/or [[Sapphire Djinn]]. ==Locations== *[[Vabbi]] **{{NPC location|Forum Highlands}} (level 24) **{{NPC location|Garden of Seborhin}} (level 24) **{{NPC location|Resplendent Makuun}} (level 24) **{{NPC location|The Hidden City of Ahdashim}} (level 24) **{{NPC location|The Mirror of Lyss}} (levels 20 and 24) ==Missions== *Vabbi **{{NPC location|Dasha Vestibule}} (level 24) ==Skills== Level 20: 14 [[Domination Magic]]
Level 24: 15 Domination Magic
Level 26: 20 Domination Magic *{{Skill icon|Energy Burn}} *{{Skill icon|Energy Surge}} ([[elite]]) *{{Skill icon|Ether Feast}} *{{Skill icon|Mistrust}} *{{Skill icon|Wastrel's Demise}} *{{Skill icon|Resurrection Signet}} - level 24 (26) only, not 20 (26). ==Armor ratings== {{NPC statistics | level = 24 | prof = me | blunt = 111 | piercing = 111 | slashing = 111 | cold = 71 | earth = 71 | fire = 71 | lightning = 71 }} ==Items dropped== *[[Ancient Lodestone]] *[[Roaring Ether Claw]] *[[Roaring Ether Heart]] ==Notes== *Level 24 (26) Roaring Ethers will only use Resurrection Signet to resurrect other Roaring Ethers, including level 20 (26) Roaring Ethers, but not the [[djinn]] in their [[mob]]. *Roaring Ether has a [[miniature]] [[Miniature Roaring Ether|version]]. {{anomaly|Unlike other elementals and the [[Roaring Ether (Depths of Tyria)|Depths of Tyria Roaring Ethers]], the Vabbian Roaring Ethers are [[fleshy]] creatures.}} ==Trivia== *The Roaring Ether is likely based on the [[w:Manticore|Manticore]], a mythical creature that resembles a red lion and which has a scorpion-like tail and a trumpet-like voice.
